recommendation: Keep this no-change audit commit as-is. No FHIR-core follow-up is needed unless a future generated publication diverges from the current source metadata.
issue_request: FHIR-34295 was a Published/Persuasive PA technical correction for R5. It reported that the R4 Marital Status ValueSet JSON had the machine name and human title flipped as "name": "Marital Status Codes" and "title": "MaritalStatus", and requested fixing them.
initial_application: No git commit explicitly mentions FHIR-34295. The correction appears to have been applied implicitly by a4993e2ff438ead32021ed417a492f73e0795bbb on 2022-09-20, which changed source/terminologies/valueset-marital-status.xml from only <name value="Marital Status Codes"/> to <name value="MaritalStatusCodes"/> plus <title value="Marital Status Codes"/>; current blame for the two metadata lines points to that commit.
additional_context: The Zulip thread linked from Jira records the terminology discussion and Grahame Grieve's instruction to file a task. PA September 2022 WGM minutes record FHIR-34295 as Persuasive with no vote needed. The active MaritalStatus binding in source/terminologies/bindings.xml references valueset-marital-status, so the checked source file remains the authoritative FHIR-core terminology input for the current build.
reconciliation: No source change was needed. Current source/terminologies/valueset-marital-status.xml has the machine-readable name MaritalStatusCodes and the human title Marital Status Codes, and a source search found no remaining occurrence of the flipped R4 name/title pair.
